name: ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
title: ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
headline: ProxyGenBench evaluates proxy-guided 3D blockout video generation
lede: Teams can now evaluate how well video generators follow animated 3D blockouts while preserving structure, filling missing content, and binding multimodal conditions.

effects.effect: Adds entity and event binding checks for video benchmarks.

appearances.title: ProxyGenBench: Benchmarking Proxy-Guided Video Generation
appearances.summary: A benchmark assesses how well video generators follow animated 3D blockouts while preserving structure, filling missing content, correcting proxy artifacts, and binding multimodal conditions to the correct entities and events.
